extension_description.message: Automatically rejects cookie banners using on-device intelligence.

popup_enabled.description: Label of the global on/off switch.

popup_pause_site.description: Label of the per-site pause switch.

popup_privacy.message: Runs entirely on this device. Nothing is sent to a server.
popup_privacy.description: Privacy note in the popup footer.

popup_no_site.description: Shown instead of the site row on pages the extension cannot run on.

status_rejected_rule.description: A known consent platform's reject button was pressed.

status_rejected_model.description: The on-device model picked the reject button.

status_carried.message: The page reloaded after the banner was rejected
status_carried.description: Shown when the site reloaded itself after the reject click, so the current document never saw a banner.

status_none.description: No cookie banner was found on this page.

status_paused.description: The extension is paused for this site.

status_skipped_uncertain.message: Skipped: not confident enough to click

status_skipped_not_consent.description: The model decided the popup was not a cookie banner.

status_skipped_none.description: The banner has no reject control.

status_skipped_no_reject.description: The banner has no reject-like control.

status_skipped_too_many.description: The banner has too many buttons to decide safely.

status_skipped_gate.description: The safety gate refused to click.

status_error_steps.description: A multi-step rule did not complete.

status_error_verify.message: Clicked reject, but the banner is still showing
status_error_verify.description: The banner did not disappear after clicking.
